}}'''Valan Luca''' is the owner and manager of ''[[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Valan Luca's Grand Traveling Show and Magnificent Display of Marvels and Wonders]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Valan Luca}}

== Appearance ==
He is a tall, dark-haired man, good-looking with a well-turned leg. He always wears a cloak gaudy enough to "shame a [[Tinker]]."

He tends towards grandiosity and exaggeration in manner and speech, and often flourishes his cloak. He takes himself very seriously.

== Activities ==
Luca's traveling circus plays an important role as it is used as cover by [[Elayne Trakand]] and her party in their journey from [[Tanchico]] to [[Salidar]].{{ref/book|5|17}} He has taken a liking to [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] under the false name Nana and swears undying love towards her when she has to leave his show at [[Samara]] due to riots breaking out between the [[Children of the Light]] and [[Masema Dagar|the Prophet]]'s men.

His circus next travels to [[Ebou Dar]] and he marries [[Latelle Luca|Latelle]] along the way. 
[[Matrim Cauthon|Mat Cauthon]]'s party uses Luca's circus as a cover while fleeing Ebou Dar, although Mat had to pay dearly for cover, as the [[Seanchan]] are looking desperately for [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], who is currently, unknown to her, the Empress of Seanchan. Both Mat and Luca are very similar in their views of women and as a result, don't tend to see eye to eye.
